title: Basket Valuation for Tailwise Autoship Customers with Claim Refunds
content:
**Loyalty team note - late-delivery fee refunds on Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders.**

For a late-delivery fee refund, the basket value is worked out from the order's line charges by the customer's Tailwise Autoship record: the claim refund entries and the shipment charge entries on any of the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions dated within the last 12 months (fewer than 12 whole months before today).

| Autoship claim refunds in the last 12 months | Autoship shipments charged in the last 12 months | Basket value |
|---|---|---|
| At least one | 6 or more | The line charges before their allocated coupon and certificate: the amount billed plus those discounts |
| At least one | At least 1 but fewer than 6 | The amount billed plus half of the allocated coupon and certificate, rounded half up to the cent |
| At least one | None | The amount billed on the line charges |
| None | any | The amount billed on the line charges |

### Worked example (hypothetical order)

Line charges billed at $88.00 after a $10.00 coupon and a $5.00 certificate:

- a customer with 1 Autoship claim refund and 8 shipments in the last 12 months: basket value $103.00;
- with 1 claim refund and 3 shipments: $88.00 plus half of $15.00, that is $95.50;
- with no claim refund: $88.00.
